name: A selective boundary between a process that explores without restriction and the report it finally emits. Behind the boundary the process may range freely, try anything, and combine its instruments however it likes; the boundary governs only what is allowed to cross into the report. It admits a statement only when that statement is the readback of something an instrument actually returned, so every claim in the report traces to a real measurement and nothing the instruments did not produce is admitted as established. Where the instruments were silent on a matter, the report's verdict on that matter is the unmarked value, neither true nor false, rather than a confident finding, so a report the instruments did not ground cannot present itself as established and its confidence is bounded to exactly what passed the boundary. The freedom lives entirely upstream of the membrane; the single constraint, that the output states only what was grounded, lives entirely at it.

VINIT.justification: the uninitialized state before any instrument is deployed or measurement taken

TANCH.justification: the terminal boundary that contains the entire set of grounded claims

AFWD.justification: the forward movement of the process into the field of exploration

AREV.justification: the return path from the instrument to the boundary for verification

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of multiple instruments to produce a complex reading

IMSCRIB.justification: the recognition of a measurement as exactly what the instrument returned

FSPLIT.justification: the decision point where a claim is tested for grounding against instrument output

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the original measurement from its verified components

EVALT.justification: the state where a claim is confirmed as a direct readback of an instrument

EVALF.justification: the state where a claim lacks a corresponding instrumental measurement

ENGAGR.justification: the state where instruments are silent and the report holds no verdict

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of a grounded claim into the append-only report

phase_3.false_description: a claim rejected for lack of grounding
phase_3.both_description: the unmarked value where instruments are silent

steps.domain_action: the inquiry begins in an uninitialized state
instruments are deployed into the unrestricted exploration space
instruments are combined to form complex investigative tools
the process identifies a specific raw measurement result
the measurement is brought back to the membrane for verification
the membrane filter tests the measurement for grounding
the measurement is confirmed as a direct readback of an instrument
the grounded claim is reconstituted for the report
the grounded claim is permanently recorded in the report
the membrane filter encounters a claim without instrumental backing
the claim is identified as ungrounded speculation
the speculation is discarded and the system returns to the filter state
the instruments remain silent on a specific matter
the unmarked silence is recorded as the bounded confidence of the report
the report is closed and the boundary is sealed

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the report contains exactly the information produced by the instruments
